# ApisAI: Smart Apiary & Blockchain Honey Traceability Platform
> An end-to-end intelligent beekeeping and cryptographic supply chain ecosystem empowering apiary MSMEs, combatting honey adulteration, and verifying product authenticity.

ApisAI unites real-time IoT colony telemetry, Google Gemini generative AI insights, immutable SHA-256 blockchain provenance, and automated WhatsApp conversational commerce into a unified platform.

## Core Capabilities
- **IoT Hive Monitoring**: Telemetry ingestion for hive internal temperature, relative humidity, colony weight gain/loss, and acoustic activity.
- **AI Colony Health Diagnostics**: Gemini-powered anomaly detection for swarming prediction, brood diseases, queen failure, and feeding interventions.
- **HoneyChain Cryptographic Traceability**: SHA-256 linked block records tracking each batch lifecycle (Harvested, Quality Tested, Packed, Labelled, Out for Sales, In Transit, Delivered).
- **Public Verification Certificates**: Consumer-facing web verification certificates accessible via on-jar QR codes showing tamper-proof cryptographic timelines.
- **Conversational Commerce**: WhatsApp AI assistant integration enabling direct-to-consumer automated order placement, customer inquiry handling, and status updates.
- **Automated Financial Administration**: Dynamic PDF invoice generation with tax (GST) calculations, digital payment reconciliation, and inventory tracking.

## Canonical URLs & Routes
- Overview Dashboard: https://apis.ai/overview
- Hive Monitoring & IoT: https://apis.ai/hives
- Harvest Records: https://apis.ai/harvests
- HoneyChain Traceability: https://apis.ai/traceability
- Honey Inventory: https://apis.ai/inventory
- Customer Orders: https://apis.ai/orders
- Payment Reconciliations: https://apis.ai/payments
- Automated PDF Invoicing: https://apis.ai/invoices
- Public Verification: https://apis.ai/verify/batch/{batch_id}

## Technology Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite 8, Apple Human Interface Design System, Hardware-accelerated CSS GPU transitions, Zero source-map production output.
- **Backend**: FastAPI (Python 3), Uvicorn, ReportLab PDF rendering engine.
- **Database & Storage**: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security), Supabase Cloud Storage.
- **AI & Integrations**: Google Gemini API, Zavu WhatsApp Cloud API, Razorpay payment gateway.
- **Security**: Cryptographic SHA-256 block hashing, HTTPS, strict Content Security Policy, and sanitized JSON-LD schemas.
